scientific_integrity: Every all-order assertion is proved analytically; exhaustive finite checks through order eight and integer sign checks through order one hundred corroborate but do not replace the proofs.
scientific_limitations: The measure is the pushforward of the uniform distribution on source permutation matrices, not uniform measure on distinct projected images or interior volume.
No claim is made concerning the full covariance eigenvalue spectrum.
Priority assessment is provisional; the Brualdi–Fritscher 2014 text was not fully accessible.
title: Covariance sign geometry of permutation X-ray polytopes and a logarithmic positive-pair law
